description: Data type 'ipAddress' holds an IPv4 or IPv6 network address, with an optional mask and an optional port or port range. Any text can be read as an ipAddress; it is not checked. Two ipAddress values are equal when they are the same text ignoring case (the hex digits of an IPv6 address); different forms of one address, such as ::1 and 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1, are not equal. It has no ordering. In a script, write one as a typed literal: "10.0.0.1"ipAddress or "10.0.0.1"ip.
